selection_process: Selection is based on a walk-in interview. Preference will be given to SC/ST candidates on equal qualifications and experience.
how_to_apply: Prepare an application on plain paper with a detailed CV including chronological discipline of degree and certificates obtained.
Include experience details covering research, industrial field, and others.
Attach attested copies of degree, certificate, and experience certificates.
Submit your application to the office of the Principal Investigator through email at [email protected].
Attend the walk-in interview on 12.10.2026 at 4:00 PM at the Physics HOD Office along with original degree, certificates, and experience certificates for verification.
important_instructions: Candidates before appearing for the interview shall ensure that they are eligible for the position they intend to apply. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview. Preference will be given to SC/ST candidates on equal qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment organisation for this post?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee under the Sponsored Research & Industrial Consultancy (SRIC).

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name in this notification?
faq.answer: The post name is Laboratory Assistant under the Department of Physics.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Laboratory Assistant position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the IIT Roorkee Laboratory Assistant?
faq.answer: The consolidated emolument is Rs. 27,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential educational qualifications?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess 10+2 qualification along with 2 years of experience in relevant work.

faq.question: Q6. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 12.10.2026 at 4:00 PM at the Physics HOD Office.

faq.question: Q7. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. What documents must be brought to the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring an application on plain paper with a detailed CV, attested copies, and original degrees, certificates, and experience certificates for verification.

faq.question: Q9. Is TA/DA provided for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview.
